question: How many customers are there?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers
FROM Customer

question: How many tracks are in the catalogue?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tracks
FROM Track

question: Which country has the most customers?
sql:
SELECT
    Country,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM
    Customer
GROUP BY
    Country
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC
LIMIT 1

question: How many customers are there in each country?
sql:
SELECT
    Country,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM
    Customer
GROUP BY
    Country
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC

question: List all media types.
sql:
SELECT Name AS media_type
FROM MediaType

question: What is the total revenue from all invoices?
sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM Invoice

question: What is the average invoice total?
sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS avg_invoice_total
FROM Invoice

question: What is the name of the longest track?
sql:
SELECT Name
FROM Track
ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC
LIMIT 1

question: How many invoices were issued in 2010?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
FROM Invoice
WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2010'

question: Which employees are Sales Support Agents?
sql:
SELECT
    Employee.FirstName || ' ' || Employee.LastName AS FullName,
    Employee.Title
FROM
    Employee
WHERE
    Employee.Title = 'Sales Support Agent'
ORDER BY
    Employee.LastName

question: How many tracks cost more than $0.99?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_tracks
FROM Track
WHERE UnitPrice > 0.99

question: How many customers have a company name recorded?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers_with_company
FROM Customer
WHERE Company IS NOT NULL

question: How many invoices were billed to Germany?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
FROM Invoice
WHERE BillingCountry = 'Germany'

question: What is the total revenue for each year?
sql:
SELECT
    strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year,
    ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM
    Invoice
GROUP BY
    year
ORDER BY
    year

question: Which 5 artists have the most albums?
sql:
SELECT
    Artist.Name AS artist_name,
    COUNT(Album.AlbumId) AS total_albums
FROM
    Artist
JOIN
    Album ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId
GROUP BY
    Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name
ORDER BY
    total_albums DESC
LIMIT 5

question: Which genre has the most tracks?
sql:
SELECT
    g.Name AS genre_name,
    COUNT(t.TrackId) AS total_tracks
FROM
    Genre g
JOIN
    Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY
    g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY
    total_tracks DESC
LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks are there in each genre?
sql:
SELECT
    Genre.Name AS genre,
    COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS track_count
FROM
    Track
JOIN
    Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId
GROUP BY
    Genre.GenreId,
    Genre.Name
ORDER BY
    track_count DESC

question: What are the titles of the albums by AC/DC?
sql:
SELECT Album.Title
FROM Album
JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId
WHERE Artist.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: How many tracks are in the 'Grunge' playlist?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count
FROM PlaylistTrack pt
JOIN Playlist p ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge'

question: Which support representative looks after the most customers?
sql:
SELECT
    Employee.FirstName || ' ' || Employee.LastName AS SupportRep,
    COUNT(Customer.CustomerId) AS total_customers
FROM
    Customer
JOIN
    Employee
    ON Customer.SupportRepId = Employee.EmployeeId
GROUP BY
    Employee.EmployeeId, SupportRep
ORDER BY
    total_customers DESC
LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 5 billing countries by total revenue?
sql:
SELECT
    BillingCountry,
    ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM
    Invoice
GROUP BY
    BillingCountry
ORDER BY
    total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total amount spent?
sql:
SELECT
    c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer_name,
    c.Company,
    ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS total_spent
FROM
    Customer c
JOIN
    Invoice i
    ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY
    c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Company
ORDER BY
    total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5

question: How many tracks are there for each media type?
sql:
SELECT
    MediaType.Name AS media_type,
    COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS total_tracks
FROM
    Track
JOIN
    MediaType
    ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY
    MediaType.Name
ORDER BY
    total_tracks DESC

question: What is the average track length in minutes for each genre?
sql:
SELECT
    Genre.Name AS genre,
    ROUND(AVG(Track.Milliseconds / 60000.0), 2) AS avg_minutes
FROM
    Track
JOIN
    Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId
GROUP BY
    Genre.Name
ORDER BY
    avg_minutes DESC

question: List the full names of all customers from Brazil.
sql:
SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName AS full_name
FROM Customer
WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: Which artist has the most tracks in the catalogue?
sql:
SELECT
    Artist.Name AS artist_name,
    COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS total_tracks
FROM
    Artist
JOIN
    Album ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId
JOIN
    Track ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId
GROUP BY
    Artist.ArtistId,
    Artist.Name
ORDER BY
    total_tracks DESC
LIMIT 1

question: Which album has the most tracks?
sql:
SELECT
    Album.Title AS album_title,
    COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS track_count
FROM
    Album
JOIN
    Track ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId
GROUP BY
    Album.AlbumId,
    Album.Title
ORDER BY
    track_count DESC
LIMIT 1

question: On average, how many invoices does a customer have?
sql:
WITH inv_counts AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId,
           COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS invoice_count
    FROM Customer c
    LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(invoice_count), 2) AS avg_invoices_per_customer
FROM inv_counts

question: How many customers does each sales support agent serve?
sql:
SELECT
    e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS SupportAgent,
    COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customer_count
FROM
    Customer c
JOIN
    Employee e
    ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
GROUP BY
    e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC

question: Which 5 genres generate the most revenue?
sql:
SELECT
    Genre.Name AS genre,
    ROUND(SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM
    InvoiceLine
JOIN
    Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
JOIN
    Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId
GROUP BY
    Genre.Name
ORDER BY
    total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

question: Which artist has earned the most revenue from track sales?
sql:
SELECT
    Artist.Name AS artist_name,
    ROUND(SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM
    InvoiceLine
JOIN
    Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
JOIN
    Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId
JOIN
    Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId
GROUP BY
    Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name
ORDER BY
    total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

question: Which sales support agent is responsible for the most revenue from their customers?
sql:
SELECT
    e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS support_agent,
    ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM Employee e
JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
WHERE e.Title = 'Sales Support Agent'
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, support_agent
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

question: Which customers have spent more than $45 in total?
sql:
SELECT
    c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer_name,
    c.Company,
    ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS total_spent
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Company
HAVING SUM(i.Total) > 45
ORDER BY total_spent DESC

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS tracks_not_purchased
FROM Track t
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM InvoiceLine il
    WHERE il.TrackId = t.TrackId
)

question: Which billing country has the highest average invoice total?
sql:
SELECT
    BillingCountry AS country,
    ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS avg_total
FROM
    Invoice
GROUP BY
    BillingCountry
ORDER BY
    avg_total DESC
LIMIT 1

question: How many employees report directly to Andrew Adams?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_reports
FROM Employee
WHERE ReportsTo = 1

question: What percentage of total revenue comes from customers in the USA?
sql:
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN BillingCountry = 'USA' THEN Total ELSE 0 END)
    / SUM(Total),
    2
) AS percent_usa
FROM Invoice

question: How many different artists have tracks in the 'Classical' playlist?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Artist.ArtistId) AS artist_count
FROM Playlist
JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Playlist.PlaylistId = PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId
JOIN Track ON PlaylistTrack.TrackId = Track.TrackId
JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId
JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId
WHERE Playlist.Name = 'Classical'

question: What is the average number of tracks per album?
sql:
WITH album_tracks AS (
  SELECT Album.AlbumId,
         COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM Album
  LEFT JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId
  GROUP BY Album.AlbumId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(track_count), 2) AS avg_tracks_per_album
FROM album_tracks

question: Which media type generates the most revenue?
sql:
SELECT
    MediaType.Name AS media_type,
    ROUND(SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM
    InvoiceLine
JOIN
    Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
JOIN
    MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY
    MediaType.MediaTypeId, MediaType.Name
ORDER BY
    total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 3 genres by number of tracks sold?
sql:
SELECT
    g.Name AS genre,
    SUM(il.Quantity) AS total_sold
FROM
    InvoiceLine il
JOIN
    Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN
    Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY
    g.Name
ORDER BY
    total_sold DESC
LIMIT 3

question: Which employee has the most people reporting directly to them?
sql:
SELECT
    e.LastName || ', ' || e.FirstName AS employee_name,
    e.Title,
    COUNT(r.EmployeeId) AS total_reports
FROM Employee e
LEFT JOIN Employee r ON r.ReportsTo = e.EmployeeId
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId
ORDER BY total_reports DESC
LIMIT 1

question: How much revenue did the Rock genre generate in each year?
sql:
SELECT
    strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) AS year,
    ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year
